notes.title: Halloween Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone!
[/h2]

Happy Halloween, we hope you’re all enjoying The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication! 
 
Today is an exciting day as we officially launch the game on consoles, and we’re bringing this patch to the PC version to ensure it’s in line with the console release. This update focuses on improving the overall gameplay experience, fixing some minor bugs, and introducing a few quality-of-life tweaks.

[h3][b]Patch Highlights for Update Ver.1.7.2[/b][/h3]

[b]System[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the video codec.
[/list]
[b]Optimisation[/b]
[list]
[*] Enhanced the spatial perception of the voice and sound effects.
[*] Updated the game's credits.
[*] Optimised multiple UI button prompts.
[*] Optimised Localisation for several languages.
[*] Optimised memory usage for textures.
[/list]
[b]General Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an error where the master tape became uninteractive after loading a saved game.
[*] Fixed an error where 'The Dark One' did not see A-Hai in specific situations.
[*] Fixed an issue where videos would play before being revealed properly.
[*] Fixed subtitles that were not properly closed during calls.
[/list]
We’re committed to making The Bridge Curse 2 the best experience possible, so keep your feedback coming! Let us know how you’re finding the game.

Thanks for your continued support and Happy Halloween! 

— The Bridge Curse 2 Team

notes.title: RESOLVED: Patch to solve the black screen issue now live
notes.content:
A patch is now live, resolving the black screen start-up issue!

Players, please update the game to v1.6.3, which will solve the black screen problem.

We are very sorry for the inconvenience caused to players.

We are currently continuing to resolve audio and voice issues, thank you very much for your patience and understanding.


We've identified a launch issue affecting a small subset of players booting The Bridge Curse 2: The Extraction. Rest assured, we're actively developing a patch to resolve this promptly.

In the interim, to get you back into the game smoothly, we recommend trying these troubleshooting steps. 

For a quick fix, many players have found success by downloading and installing the VP9 Video Extensions available on the Microsoft Store.

Additionally, consider these options:

1. If you have third-party video player software installed, we advise either uninstalling it or disabling it temporarily.

2. For Windows 10 users, ensure your system is updated to at least version 1809.

3. If your computer has both an independent GPU and a built-in GPU, we recommend disabling the one not in use currently.

We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to resolve this.
